Covers from Anlan Yuan of Haining Zhou in Zhejiang Sheng to Jian Shan in the east coast. The road is ca. 81 kilometers in length.

Covers from Anlan Yuan of Haining Zhou in Zhejiang Sheng to Jian Shan in the east coast. The road is ca. 81 kilometers in length. Shows section of road in Haining Zhou, possibly constructed in Ming Dynasty and repaired in Qing Dynasty. Pictorial map. Wood block print. Includes text. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. Previous call number: G7824.H14 1772 .A5 Vault
